categories.main_business_segments: Jiangsu Feiliks International Logistics Inc. primarily operates in two main segments: comprehensive logistics services and international freight forwarding logistics services. Comprehensive logistics includes inbound logistics management, production logistics, finished goods logistics, land transportation and warehousing, multimodal transport, value-added services, outsourcing, global after-sales spare parts logistics, and low-carbon green circular packaging. International freight forwarding covers sea freight, air freight, and integrated global door-to-door supply chain solutions.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company leverages advanced logistics technologies such as automated handling robots, automated conveyor sorting systems, narrow aisle forklifts, non-standard automation, AI vision technology, and intelligent warehouse management systems. It also develops digital platforms including order management systems (OMS), robotic process automation (RPA), AI-based data query assistants, and integrated customs management systems to enhance operational efficiency and service quality. The company emphasizes digital transformation and AI integration to optimize supply chain processes.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Feiliks serves primarily intelligent manufacturing enterprises, focusing on industries such as electronic information manufacturing, automotive and auto parts, new energy, and photovoltaics. Its key customers include brand owners, manufacturers, and suppliers within these sectors. The company also supports global after-sales spare parts logistics and provides tailored supply chain solutions to meet diverse customer needs.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates extensively across China with significant presence in Suzhou, Shanghai, Southwest China, and other regions. Internationally, it has a broad global network covering over 50 countries and regions across five continents, including Southeast Asia (notably Vietnam, Thailand, Malaysia, Singapore), North America, Europe, and South America. It has established subsidiaries and operational bases in key overseas markets to support global supply chain services.
categories.supply_chain_position: Feiliks operates primarily in the midstream and downstream segments of the supply chain, providing integrated supply chain management, warehousing, transportation, and logistics services. It acts as a logistics service provider and freight forwarder, facilitating the movement and management of goods from suppliers through manufacturing to end customers, including after-sales support.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company’s strategic focus is on becoming a data and technology-driven intelligent manufacturing supply chain management expert. It prioritizes digital transformation, AI application, and green supply chain development. Key R&D initiatives include development of digital employee platforms (RPA), intelligent customs management systems, AI-powered data query assistants, and integrated order management systems. It also invests in green logistics technologies and sustainable supply chain solutions.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated primarily through service fees from comprehensive logistics services and international freight forwarding. This includes charges for warehousing, transportation, value-added services, customs clearance, and supply chain management solutions. The company operates on a direct sales model, billing customers based on contract terms and service delivery milestones.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Feiliks is ranked among the top logistics providers in China, holding positions such as 9th in international freight forwarding logistics warehousing revenue and 12th among private international freight forwarders. It is recognized as a leading green logistics enterprise and a top 50 private logistics company in China. The company competes with other major logistics and freight forwarding firms by leveraging its integrated service offerings, technological innovation, and global network.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, Feiliks reported operating revenue of approximately RMB 6.62 billion, representing a 31.69% increase over 2023. International freight forwarding revenue grew by 50.06%, and comprehensive logistics services revenue increased by 9.52%. Despite revenue growth, net profit attributable to shareholders was negative RMB 11.74 million, declining 153.85% year-over-year, mainly due to increased costs, business restructuring, and investment in new energy vehicle supply chains. The company’s total assets were about RMB 3.96 billion, with steady growth in cash flow from operations.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Feiliks emphasizes integrated, end-to-end supply chain solutions tailored for intelligent manufacturing industries, combining comprehensive logistics and international freight forwarding services. Its competitive differentiation lies in advanced digital and automation technologies, extensive warehousing resources, global network coverage, and commitment to green logistics and sustainability. The company offers customized, flexible logistics solutions that enhance efficiency, reduce costs, and support customers’ global expansion and green supply chain goals.
